'''Garumand''' was a [[Saldaean]] captain and distant cousin of Queen [[Tenobia Kazadi]].

==Appearance==
He was a handsome man with a thick mustache.

==Activities==
Garumand was in charge of the guards for [[Graendal]]'s estate in [[Natrin's Barrow]]. Garumand was killed when Rand used [[balefire]] on the palace.{{ref/book|13|p}}
